content: Poisson (log link canonical): eta=log(mu), mu=exp(eta), g'(mu)=1/mu, V(mu)=mu. IRLS weight w_i=mu_i, working response z_i=eta_i+(y_i-mu_i)/mu_i. Deviance D=2*sum(y_i*log(y_i/mu_i)-(y_i-mu_i)). Log-likelihood ll=sum(y_i*log(mu_i)-mu_i-lgamma(y_i+1)). Gamma (inverse link canonical): eta=1/mu, mu=1/eta, g'(mu)=-1/mu^2, V(mu)=mu^2. IRLS weight w_i=1/mu_i^2, working response z_i=eta_i+(y_i-mu_i)*(-1/mu_i^2). Deviance D=2*sum((y_i-mu_i)/mu_i - log(y_i/mu_i)). Gamma log-likelihood requires dispersion: ll=sum(-y_i/mu_i - log(mu_i)) (up to dispersion-dependent terms). Gaussian (identity): eta=mu, w_i=1, z_i=y_i. Deviance D=sum((y_i-mu_i)^2). Binomial deviance D=2*sum(y_i*log(y_i/mu_i)+(1-y_i)*log((1-y_i)/(1-mu_i))).
